dropped.item: Framing of the call's purpose as discussing 'where we might fit' (exploratory, fit-finding) reduced to a generic 'talk'

changed.item: Original asks a tentative question ('Could we help Fairview Markets cover regular routes or last-minute delivery needs?'). The edit turns it into a confident assertion ('We could cover Fairview Markets' regular routes or last-minute deliveries'), which raises certainty and drops the invitation for the recipient to weigh in.
